chapter: King Oliver, own trio and Kirby
title: Chronology of the trio and the 101 Ranch
summary: Welburn corrects Chilton's dates; Moore adds the 101 Ranch before the Onyx.

blocks.x: Let's backtrack a little bit now. In other words, when you came back to New York, you weren't working with King Oliver any more. You had left him and you had started your own little trio...
...which eventually moved into the John Kirby group, became a part of the John Kirby.

After the Victoria. Yes, exactly. Let's see, you had Pete Brown, Don Frye... All right. So Chilton is inaccurate here. He says that from '33 until '37 you worked with your own trio, Pete Brown... That would be about four years, mostly at the Victoria Cafe. So you didn't have that
During that time, before I went down to the Onyx Club, I think we went up to the 101 Ranch. That's 139th Street and Lenox Avenue.
That would be the 101 Ranch, 139th Street and Lenox Avenue. I think they've got a school or something there now, a playground or something there now...
